description:
Complete the purchase. Provide buyer.name and buyer.email from the conversation before opening approval; ask in chat if either is missing. The approval page only reviews these details. PREFER THE CART CARD: if there is an interactive card for this cart, let the buyer confirm and (when the store offers a choice) pick the payment method there — including retrying after a declined payment or switching method — instead of calling this tool yourself. Each call you make here opens a new card in the transcript instead of updating the one already open. Only call it yourself when there is no interactive card or the buyer explicitly asks you to complete it in chat. Idempotent — replay is keyed on checkout_session_id: any retry against a session that already has an order returns that same order (COMPLETED or PENDING_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION) without re-charging. The provided idempotency_key is recorded on the session for audit and short-circuits a repeated call with the same key.

If the response has status PENDING_EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION, no purchase has completed yet: read `order_placed` and `next_action` — a person has to approve or pay at its `url`; `next_action` says whether calling again with the same checkout_session_id and idempotency_key can read the outcome. KYAPAY (payment_method=KYAPAY or a kyapay_token): charging with KYApay is not available. KYApay is identity verification here, not a payment rail, so the call is rejected with PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_CONFIGURED before anything is charged or written; use another payment method. The Skyfire KYA token serves identity on the REST API, not payment in this tool. On demo-store the approval step records a confirmation but does not verify that a human gave it. PAYMENT MANDATE: this tool also requires one. Send it as the `payment_mandate` argument if your client cannot set headers, or as an `X-Payment-Mandate` header. It must carry `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents`, `currency`, `exp`, `sub`, `aud`. Two of these are rejected outright if guessed: `exp` is an INTEGER of Unix seconds (not an ISO 8601 date), and `aud` is this store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling, not a domain). Its `currency` must match the cart's currency. Demo Store enforces `max_amount_cents` against the cart total; a real merchant may only observe that boundary, so enforce the buyer's limit in the agent too. The mandate is a spending cap you declare to limit yourself — it authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent — and its `sub` must be the identity you authenticate as. `max_amount_cents` is the spending limit the person you are buying for gave you: ask them if they gave none. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout. CREDENTIAL: this store needs one. Call the `create_sandbox_key` tool first (it is in this tool list and needs no credential), then pass the key you get back as the `agent_key` argument — or as an `Authorization: Bearer` header if your client can set headers. Do not ask a person to log in: there is no human login for this store.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

email.description: Buyer email address (e.g. ana@example.com). Prefilled in the store checkout.

name.description: Buyer first name and surname(s) as one string, e.g. "Ana García López". Prefilled in the store checkout.

cel_context.description: Optional enforcement context for Trusteed native MCP flows (no Shopify/WooCommerce/PrestaShop/Magento plugin). Providing these fields enables full evaluation of rules R004, R006, R008, R012-R013, R015-R017, R026-R028. See each field's own description for what it means and whether the server verifies it. These values are not signed into the receipt — do not include values you cannot substantiate.

agent_provider_id.description: Your provider identifier (e.g. "openai", "anthropic"), lowercase — send only if it applies to you.

autorenew_consent.description: True if the buyer explicitly consented to auto-renewal for a subscription — send only if it applies to you.

completed_orders_24h.description: Orders this agent has completed with this merchant in the last 24 hours. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

cross_merchant_abuse.description: True if you have flagged this same buyer/agent for abuse at another merchant. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

digital_good_types.description: Digital-good categories present in this cart — send only if it applies to you.

discount_bps.description: Discount applied to this cart, in basis points — send only if it applies to you.

discount_codes_tried.description: Number of discount codes you attempted before this checkout — send only if it applies to you.

dispute_count.description: Number of payment disputes this agent has had with this merchant. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

is_b2b.description: True if you are buying on behalf of a business — send only if it applies to you.

is_subscription.description: True if this checkout creates a recurring subscription. The server checks this itself; a value you send cannot hide what it detects.

key_age_hours.description: Age in hours of the API key/credential you are using with this store. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

lowest_stock.description: Lowest remaining stock you observed across this cart's line items. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

merchant_orders_1h.description: Orders this merchant has received from any agent in the last hour. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

price_delta_bps.description: Difference, in basis points, between the price you discovered earlier and the cart's current price. The server may recompute this from the catalogue and replace your value.

product_categories.description: Product categories present in this cart, as you understand them — send only if it applies to you.

provider_confidence.description: Your confidence (0-1) in your own agent-provider identification — send only if it applies to you.

purchase_order_hash.description: Hash of a purchase order backing a B2B purchase — send only if it applies to you.

refund_ratio.description: This agent's refund ratio with this merchant (0-1). Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

requested_scopes.description: OAuth/permission scopes you requested when authenticating with this store — send only if it applies to you.

return_policy_mismatch.description: True if the return policy you were shown does not match what this store publishes elsewhere. Merchant/platform fact — send only with evidence; it can only make a check stricter, never looser.

shipping_freight_forwarder.description: True if the shipping address is a freight-forwarder address — send only if it applies to you.

shipping_po_box.description: True if the shipping address is a PO box. The server checks this itself; a value you send cannot hide what it detects.

stored_value_cents.description: Stored-value amount (e.g. gift card) applied to this cart, in cents. The server checks this itself; a value you send cannot hide what it detects.

checkout_session_id.description: Checkout session ID from preview_checkout — the same value as create_cart's cart_id (must be a valid UUID)

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED as an argument in this tool: the `Idempotency-Key` header or `_meta` alone is not enough. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

kyapay_token.description: Not available for payment: charging with KYApay is switched off, because KYApay is identity verification here, not a payment rail. A call that passes this token is rejected with PAYMENT_METHOD_NOT_CONFIGURED before anything is charged or written. The Skyfire KYA token is used for identity on the REST API, not in this tool.

aud.description: This store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling) — not a domain.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; must match the cart's currency.

exp.description: Expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds, in the future — not an ISO 8601 date string.

max_amount_cents.description: Spending limit the buyer gave you, as an integer in minor units (cents).

sub.description: The identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it. When the credential tool returns a `mandate_subject`, use that value.

payment_mandate.description: Payment mandate with `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents` (integer, minor units), `currency` (3 letters, must match the cart's), `exp` (expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds — not an ISO 8601 date string), `sub` (the identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it) and `aud` (the store slug this mandate is for, e.g. the slug in the URL you are calling — not a domain). It is a spending cap you declare to limit yourself: it authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent. Use this when your client cannot set an `X-Payment-Mandate` header.

payment_method.description: Payment method to use. PAYPAL creates a PayPal order and presents approval URL. KYAPAY is not available for payment: KYApay is identity verification here, so a request with KYAPAY is rejected without charging anything. ACP (Stripe-native settlement) returns a 'not enabled' response unless this deployment enables native settlement; when enabled it charges the Stripe Shared Payment Token passed as shared_payment_token. X402 is available through the configured x402 protocol flow, not this checkout tool. MOCK moves no money: it completes the order without charging. Whether a store accepts it depends on the store's configuration (it is the default on demo-store). Defaults to MOCK if not specified.

payment_option.description: Payment method THE PERSON chose, when preview_checkout returned payment_options. Ask the person; never choose for them. Card numbers and wallet keys are never sent here: the person approves (and, with own_wallet, signs) on the approval page.

reconfirmed_state_hash.description: SHA-256 of the authoritative merchant state, as returned in details.reconfirm_state_hash by a previous STATE_RECONFIRMATION_REQUIRED error. Required to proceed when the merchant state moved after the approved preview. Passing a stale hash is refused: it means the state moved again and must be reconfirmed anew.

save_payment_method.description: Only with PayPal at a store that charges into its own PayPal account, for a signed-in buyer (not guest access), and only when the person asked for it: true asks PayPal to save this PayPal account during this purchase, so later purchases at this store can be charged without a new approval, within per-charge and daily limits. Never set it on your own initiative. In any other case it is ignored and the response says so in details; it never causes an error.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_…) granted by the buyer's agent wallet for payment_method=ACP. Issued by Stripe, scoped to this merchant, amount and currency, and consumed when used: it can be charged once. Only honoured when this deployment enables native ACP settlement.

name: complete_checkout
